description: Search Yandex News / Dzen News by keyword, browse a category, read homepage top stories, or fetch story clusters by URL. Returns every linked article, source counts, topics and dates.

category.description: Rubric to browse (mode=browseCategory). `all` reads all 16 rubrics in one run.
category.title: Category

excludeDomains.description: Drop a cluster when any linked article is from one of these domains.
excludeDomains.title: Exclude source domains

excludeKeywords.description: Drop a cluster when its headline, summary or an article headline/summary contains any of these values.
excludeKeywords.title: Excluded keywords

excludePublishers.description: Drop a cluster when any linked source name contains one of these values (case-insensitive).
excludePublishers.title: Exclude publishers

includeArticles.description: Emit one record per linked article in every cluster. Turn this off for a story-only dataset.
includeArticles.title: Include article records

includeDetails.description: Fetch the cluster page for topic labels, source-reported counts, images, country/region, comments and likes.
includeDetails.title: Include story details

includeDomains.description: Keep a cluster when at least one linked article is from one of these domains (for example `rbc.ru`).
includeDomains.title: Include source domains

includeKeywords.description: Keep a cluster when its headline, summary or an article headline/summary contains at least one of these values.
includeKeywords.title: Required keywords

includePublishers.description: Keep a cluster when any linked source name contains one of these values (case-insensitive).
includePublishers.title: Include publishers

maxArticlesPerStory.description: Maximum article records and article pages fetched per cluster. Yandex returns 100 articles per page.
maxArticlesPerStory.title: Maximum articles per story

maxStories.description: Maximum number of story clusters to return across the whole run. Yandex search depth varies by query.
maxStories.title: Maximum story clusters

mode.description: What to scrape. `searchNews` searches keywords, `browseCategory` reads a rubric feed, `topStories` reads the homepage sections, and `byStoryUrls` resolves specific story clusters.
mode.title: Mode

publishedAfter.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (mode=searchNews). Leave blank for no lower bound.
publishedAfter.title: Published after

publishedBefore.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (mode=searchNews). Leave blank for no upper bound.
publishedBefore.title: Published before

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords or phrases (mode=searchNews). Russian and English queries are supported. The daily-test prefill uses one query.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortOrder.description: Order of the returned search clusters (mode=searchNews). Yandex search itself is relevance-ranked; these options sort the returned set.
sortOrder.title: Sort order

storyUrls.description: Dzen News story or instory URLs, or bare cluster UUIDs (mode=byStoryUrls). A bare numeric persistent ID is not a valid cluster URL.
storyUrls.title: Story URLs or cluster IDs

timeRange.description: Keep clusters published in this window (mode=searchNews). Applied to the results Yandex returns. A custom date range overrides this field.
timeRange.title: Publication time

title: Yandex News Story Clusters Input
